provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Witcher: Path of Destiny rulebook (Go On Board, via RulesPal)

modules.name: The Edge of the World
modules.note: Easiest; for a first game skip Extra Effort cards and Side Quests.

modules.name: Legendary Monsters (co-op)
modules.note: Fight a Legendary Monster together; no other modules.

modules.name: Wild Hunt (one vs all)
modules.note: One player (or the Automa solo) plays the Wild Hunt.

steps.text: Playmat on the table with room for each Player board and Timeline
Choose a Legendary Monster; its cards on the playmat, side for your player count up; Destiny tokens nearby
Tale card deck on its spot, cover faceup like a book
steps.note: Wild Hunt: use its own Tale cards

steps.text: Destiny and Path tokens by the Tale cards: Destiny III at the bottom, II, then I on top
Shuffle the Main deck facedown; a faceup pair of cards on each of {n} rows
steps.note: Legendary Monsters: first remove Main deck cards 2, 7, 9 and 50

steps.text: Extra Experience token next to the bottom available row
Symbol tokens on the table
Whoever last read a Witcher book picks first: shuffle Player boards facedown, take 2, keep 1, return 1; clockwise
steps.note: Legendary Monsters: Dandelion may not be chosen; no Side Quests

steps.text: Regular Experience marker on 0; Golden marker on the spot shown right of the track
1 Ability token active side up on the leftmost Ability; the other 3 beside the board
Standees on the Initiative track in the Tale's order (highest closest to the Tale cards)
One Player token on 0 of the Victory Point track
Your 5 starting Action cards as your hand; Side Quest card tucked faceup under your board
Health Point tokens: {n} each
Runestone cards for your player count faceup by the playmat
steps.note: Easier: add 1-2 marked cards; harder: remove 1-2

steps.text: Trail cards in 3 piles by Chapter number, each shuffled facedown
Optional: Lambert or Eskel Companion rules
Automa board of a remaining character as the second player; its Experience markers and VP token as normal
Solo Mode Destiny token nearby; box the Automa character's other components
Monster miniature next to the playmat
Monster Movement deck for your player count, shuffled, by the playmat
Monster Life Points counter at {n}
Monster-specific: Ancient Leshen - Root tokens nearby; Hym - Suffering tokens nearby; Katakan - Power token on its card's start position for your player count
Finish setup with the chosen Tale's own section in the rulebook
Generals playmat next to the main playmat, in front of the Wild Hunt player
One player takes the Wild Hunt (solo: the Automa controls it): 6 Action cards in hand, 5 Ability markers with 1 active on the leftmost Ability
Ciri's Victory Point marker on 0 (solo and 2 players: on 9); Wild Hunt scoring miniature on 0
Use this expansion's Side Quest cards, on the side for your number of Heroes
General Trait deck in 4 piles; 1 random card of each faceup in order: Imlerith, Eredin, Nithral, Caranthir
General Weakness deck in 4 piles, each shuffled facedown on its space
4 Generals miniatures on their starting spaces
Naglfar miniature next to the Generals playmat
Shuffle the 4 Broken Sextant cards, remove 1 from the game, the rest facedown by the Generals playmat
Turn over the first Tale card and read the introduction
Chapter 1: draft cards, then the Monster moves or attacks
